skill.summary: Assesses wind turbine blade condition from visual inspection data. Classifies damage type and severity (1-5) across seven failure modes and recommends repair...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of wind-turbine-blade-inspection skill.
- Classifies visual inspection findings into seven damage types across defined blade zones and surfaces.
- Assigns severity (1–5) to each finding, with clear action recommendations.
- Provides structured inspection reports with operational, repair, and monitoring guidance.
- Includes strict rules for escalation (e.g., lightning, large debonds, fiber exposure, ice).
- Designed for both drone and ground-based inspection data inputs.
